title: Project scaffold + SQLite graph schema
description:
Stand up the ingestion project skeleton that every later ticket builds on. Create a Node.js project (package.json, ESM) under an `ingest/` (or `src/ingest/`) folder with an `npm run ingest` entry point that runs end-to-end even on zero input. Define the SQLite schema: `nodes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, type TEXT, name TEXT, attrs_json TEXT)` and `edges(id INTEGER PK, src TEXT, rel TEXT, dst TEXT, attrs_json TEXT)` with indexes on nodes.type, nodes.name, edges.src, edges.rel, edges.dst. Use better-sqlite3 (synchronous, zero-config). Establish the folder layout for parsers/mappers/exporters and a shared db helper module. No data extraction yet — just the runnable skeleton and schema.

Part of Phase 1 (Ingestion pipeline). Storage decision: SQLite nodes+edges + generated graph.json. See PROJECT.md and project-context.
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` and `npm run ingest` complete with exit code 0 on a fresh checkout
Running ingest creates a SQLite database file with `nodes` and `edges` tables matching the documented schema
Indexes exist on nodes.type, nodes.name, edges.src, edges.rel, edges.dst
A shared db helper module opens/initializes the database and is importable by other modules
Re-running ingest is idempotent (drops/recreates or upserts cleanly, no duplicate-schema errors)
